people.name: Ehud
people.line: Left-handed Benjamite judge who delivered Israel from Moabite oppression

people.name: Seirah
people.line: Place where Ehud escaped after killing Eglon

translations.web: Ehud escaped while they waited, passed beyond the stone idols, and escaped to Seirah.
translations.bsb: Ehud, however, had escaped while the servants waited. He passed by the idols and escaped to Seirah.
translations.kjv: And Ehud escaped while they tarried, and passed beyond the quarries, and escaped unto Seirath.
translations.asv: And Ehud escaped while they tarried, and passed beyond the quarries, and escaped unto Seirah.
